notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least four +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Deepglow Skate.
Deepglow Skate enters the battlefield, doubling the number of counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Repeat.
